provider: PulsedMedia Storage Boxes — 4 TB at €8.99/mo + a genuinely free 50 GiB/30-day box

free_tier.stated: A separate free seedbox lasts 30 days with 50 GiB storage and 200 GiB torrent traffic, one per customer, and showed 'Available: 0'. Storage Boxes are paid (see notes).

egress.terms: Internet egress is unlimited at 100 Mbps (about 30 TB per month, 1 TB per day) plus 10 Gbps burst of 500 GiB per month; ingress is unlimited at 10 Gbps.

tooling: SSH, SCP, SFTP, FTP(S), HTTPS. Docker rootless means you can run rclone or a WebDAV server inside it.
chaining: The free box is explicitly one-per-customer with a newsletter signup as the price ('Signing up for FREE Seedbox you enroll to marketing newsletter maximum twice per month'; 'Only 1 Seedbox per user!'). Not stackable — the provider says outright that the guardrails exist because 'a free seedbox is catnip for spammers and ratio-cheaters', which in plain terms means the free box attracts users who take more than it is meant for.

limits.value: 100 Mbps (about 30 TB per month, 1 TB per day)

limits_note: Free seedbox: 50 GiB storage, terminates after 30 days, 200 GiB torrent traffic, 'Available: 0' at read time. Paid boxes are shaped by internet egress (see limits).
reliability_note: Own hardware in Finland at two datacenters, Lauttasaari (Helsinki) and Kerava. The free seedbox is rationed to one per customer with limited slots. unverified: tenure of the host.
